name: Sinks Canyon State Park (Popo Agie Campground)
inclusion_evidence: reserve.wyoming.gov (US eDirect API wyordr.usedirect.com/wyomingrdr/rdr/, PlaceId 15 'Sinks Canyon State Park'), FacilityId 384 'Popo Agie' (facility point 42.74165,-108.8221), search/grid + search/details read 2026-11-20: 12 web-bookable 'Campsite Non-Electric' units (IsRVSite true) 01, 03, 04, 05, 09, 10, 11, 13, 17, 18, 19, 24 with paved pads, 'Unit & Parking Size(ft)' 45 (01), 40 (04), 36 (03, 09, 10), 30 (05, 11, 17, 18, 19), 18 (13), 24 dims 35x16; site 17 'not recommended for RV's over 30ft'; every unit 'Back In'; plus 8 tent sites (TE02, TE07, TE14, TE16, TE20-TE23) and a non-bookable HOST pad; Rate 10.00 Nightly, MaximumStay 14 -> real drive-in RV campground, a 23-ft rig fits 11 of the 12 RV pads. Wyoming State Parks 'Campsites for RVs' page (wyoparks.wyo.gov/index.php/activities-amenities-sinks-canyon/campsites-for-rvs-sinks-canyon, read as search-result text 2026-11-20; the site answers an F5 challenge): 'Popo Agie campground offers 24 sites for tents and small trailers/campers. There is very limited availability for large trailers.' Park page capture 2026-10-12 (audit/state_park_fees/wy_pages_2026-10-12.json): 'Sites 12 and 15 in the Popo Agie Campground are first come first-served year round.' Imagery 2026-11-20 (Esri World_Imagery, 200 m half-width, every unit point plotted): paved loop south of WY-131 with its own entrances off the highway, pads matching the unit points, the yurt sites at the west end. Sawmill Campground (FacilityId 385), 2.56 km down-canyon, was split out 2026-11-20. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Popo Agie is the larger of Sinks Canyon State Park's two campgrounds, on the Middle Fork Popo Agie River SW of Lander. Pads 03-05 in the cul-de-sac at the west end sit closest to the river. The park calls room for large trailers very limited. A separate USFS Sinks Canyon campground lies farther up-canyon. --Claude

sites.note: 12 bookable RV pads and 8 tent sites, plus first-come sites 12 and 15; site 13's pad is 18 ft.

facilities.note: Water is shut off in mid-October.

season.note: Off season (Oct 1 - Apr 30) access depends on the weather.

booking.note: Reservations May 1 - Sep 30; sites 12 and 15 are first-come year round, and every site is first-come Oct 1 - Apr 30.

fees.note: Wyoming's statewide schedule: the base camping rate plus sales & lodging tax per vehicle; Sinks Canyon charges no day-use fee.
